svg.title: Ending: The Flake
svg.desc: Ending card, The Flake: the bark above, the yard below. Above, the survivors at the raw new edge of their city: Old Resin lights the pot and someone cuts the first ring of a new door. Below, a flake of bark lies face down in the grass, and its underside is not solid.
svg.text: The Trunk shrugged. They began again.
